question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.**

A lover of mankind
solution:
The correct answer is **"Philanthropist."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Philanthropist"** is a noun that refers to a person who loves mankind and is actively involved in promoting human welfare. (दान आदि के द्वारा ज़रूरतमंदों की सहायता करने वाला व्‍यक्ति; परोपकारी व्‍यक्ति, लोकोपकारक)

 
 
• **Example**: *Bill Gates is a well-known **philanthropist**__ who has donated billions of dollars to various charities and causes.*
 
 
 
• The word is derived from the Greek words 'philos' meaning 'loving' and 'anthropos' meaning 'human being'.
 
• So, a lover of mankind is called Philanthropist.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Misanthrope (Option 1)** refers to a person who hates or distrusts mankind. (मनुष्य से घृणा करनेवाला; मानवद्वेषी)
 
• **Narcissist (Option 3) **refers to a person who is excessively self-absorbed and has an inflated sense of self-importance. (एक व्यक्ति जो अत्यधिक आत्म-लीन है और जिसमें आत्म-महत्व की भावना बढ़ी हुई है)
 
• **Lexicographer (Option 4)** refers to a person who writes or compiles dictionaries. (शब्दकोशों का लेखन करनेवाला व्यक्ति; कोशकार)
